name: Select required artifact
description: Select the durable artifact that should be created or updated for the current governed intent.
when_to_use: Use after next_intent when determining how the result/state transition should be represented durably.

artifact_type.instructions: Choose the durable artifact appropriate to this governed intent. Prefer updating an existing applicable artifact over creating a duplicate. Execute records a result: the Work Item state update plus linked evidence. Choose none_required when durable state/evidence can be updated without a separate artifact. Choose other_needs_new when a necessary artifact type is absent. Choose unclear_needs_review when current context cannot determine the artifact.

criteria.result: Durable outcome of a governed lifecycle transition: the work item's state update plus linked evidence and the accepted/rejected outcome.
criteria.evidence: Evidence object when evidence itself is the durable output.
criteria.none_required: No separate artifact is required; update existing durable state/evidence.
criteria.other_needs_new: A required artifact type is missing from the registry.
criteria.unclear_needs_review: Insufficient context to identify the correct artifact.

changelog.reason: Phase 1B finding: systematic result->work_item_change confusion on close intent (4/4); Ben decision 2026-09-28: merge, keep result
